scope: Source-local absorption-cache channel implementation and single-source regression evidence

implementation.cache_format: RGBA16Float 3D texture; red stores source-zero optical depth and green stores source-one optical depth
implementation.source_zero_domain: Existing renderer volume bounds; existing primary authored fire-light path
implementation.source_one_domain: Emitter origin plus [-3,-0.6,-3] to [3,7.4,3]; light position uses the required colocated primary fire light
implementation.fallback: Other lights and samples outside each source cache domain use direct integration

single_source_capture.scope_limit: This is the existing one-emitter approximate-cache comparison; it does not exercise the green channel.

acceptance_gaps: The scene validator accepts one emitter, so the source-one cache branch has not been exercised in a dual-source frame.
No source-one image-quality, temporal-error, or performance measurements exist.
Shadow maps remain primary-source only; Windows/DX12 and other-adapter acceptance remain open.
